canonicalIngredients.name: beef chuck / stewing beef
observations: 1 kg chuck, whole or large pieces (s0)

canonicalIngredients.name: stock or water
observations: 1 cup beef stock or water + cube (s1)

causalSequence: whisk curry paste, coconut milk, stock, fish sauce, sugar into a sauce
layer potatoes, beef, onion in slow cooker; pour sauce over
drop in cinnamon stick, star anise
slow-cook low 8 h or high 4-5 h until beef falls apart
adjust with fish sauce, sugar, tamarind to taste
serve over jasmine rice; top with peanuts, coriander
techniqueFacts: all 4 sources use or endorse store-bought paste; 2 name Maesri canned paste specifically
3 of 4 slow-cook low 8 h / high 4-6 h; the stovetop source simmers 1.5 h total
chuck or other connective-tissue cuts named best in all 4 sources
waxy potatoes hold shape better than floury during long cooking (2 sources)
peanuts go on at the end as topping, not cooked through (3 sources)
fish sauce / sugar / tamarind balance is adjusted after cooking, to taste (2 sources)
browning the beef is optional — 2 slow-cooker sources skip it entirely
1 source dredges beef in plain wheat flour to thicken — gluten free cell must swap (cornflour) or thicken by reducing/mashing potato (2 sources thicken that way)
curry is mild by nature; extra paste or fresh chilli lifts heat (2 sources)
slow-cooker versions run thinner; sauce thickens as potatoes break down (2 sources)
